questions.question: What did God tell the aging Joshua?
options: That he should appoint a king over Israel
That a famine was coming upon the land
That much land still remained to be possessed
That his work was finished and he could rest
questions.answer: That much land still remained to be possessed

questions.question: Which tribe received no land inheritance, having the LORD as their inheritance?
The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh received land east of the Jordan.
Joshua was old, and the LORD said very much _____ remained to be possessed.
The tribe of _____ received no land, for the LORD was their inheritance.
